name: @loomex/codex-plugin
description: Local Loomex MCP bridge for Codex desktop and CLI

scripts.build: npm run ui:sync && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild src/lifecycle/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/lifecycle.mjs && esbuild src/compatibility-export.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/compatibility-export.mjs && esbuild scripts/export-plugin-components.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/compatibility-check.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:compile && node --test --test-concurrency=1 .test-dist/*.test.js
scripts.test:ui: npm run design:sync && npm run build && npm run test:compile && LOOMEX_REQUIRE_BROWSER=1 node --test .test-dist/ui-browser.test.js
scripts.test:cross-boundary: cargo build --manifest-path ../runner/Cargo.toml --example presentation-fixture && npm run test:compile && LOOMEX_PRESENTATION_FIXTURE=../runner/target/debug/examples/presentation-fixture node --test .test-dist/runner-journal-integration.test.js
